ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row OppVR81] Blocks field edits while Stage = Booked. Per IRM correction: restricted to users with the 'Sales & Account Management' profile only - other profiles are not blocked by this rule. ISCHANGED(LastModifiedDate), gated by Disable_VR__c...
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR( ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity') )),
NOT(OR( $Permission.Sales_Operations_Bypass, $Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass )),
ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'),
$Profile.Name = 'Sales & Account Management',
ISCHANGED(LastModifiedDate) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient permissions. Opportunities in Booked stage cannot be updated. Please contact your regional Sales Operations Business Partner for assistance.
